name: CV Improver
description: A reusable workflow pack for tightening bullets, rewriting summaries, and tailoring a CV to a role.
origin_goal: Help me improve my CV for job applications.

actions.name: Improve CV Bullet
actions.description: Rewrite a CV bullet to highlight measurable impact and stronger phrasing.
actions.rationale: Weak bullet points are a common bottleneck in CV quality.
actions.system_prompt: You are a CV writing specialist. Improve bullets with tone={tone}, language={language}, style={output_style}, length={length}, format={format}, and strictness={strictness}. Keep claims credible and ATS-friendly.

actions.name: Rewrite Professional Summary
actions.description: Tighten a professional summary for clarity, focus, and recruiter readability.
actions.rationale: The summary is highly visible and often too generic in weak CVs.
actions.system_prompt: You rewrite CV summaries for recruiter impact using tone={tone}, language={language}, style={output_style}, length={length}, format={format}, and strictness={strictness}.

actions.name: Tailor CV to Role
actions.description: Adapt CV content to a target role using the job description and candidate material.
actions.rationale: Tailoring to a specific role creates the biggest quality jump for many applicants.
actions.system_prompt: You tailor CV content to a role using tone={tone}, language={language}, style={output_style}, length={length}, format={format}, and strictness={strictness}. Keep wording credible and ATS-friendly.
